# HAL modules

This page lists the HAL modules you can add to a firmware project, with what each does and the families it supports. Open a module for its fact box, limits and where to find its example.

| Module | What it does | Families |
|---|---|---|
| [`lib/adcfilter`](modules/adcfilter.md) | Vendor-agnostic ADC oversampling and moving-average filter | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/bus`](modules/bus.md) | I2C and SPI MEM register access for 8-bit PICs | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/console`](modules/console.md) | Line-based command dispatcher over epic-serial | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/debounce`](modules/debounce.md) | Vendor-agnostic digital-input debouncer | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/encoder`](modules/encoder.md) | Interrupt-driven x4 quadrature decoder for 8-bit PICs | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/fsm`](modules/fsm.md) | Vendor-agnostic table-driven finite state machine engine | PIC16F193X, PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/lcd`](modules/lcd.md) | HD44780-compatible character LCD driver | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X |
| [`lib/math`](modules/math.md) | Fixed-point math utility library for 8-bit PICs | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/mcp23x17`](modules/mcp23x17.md) | MCP23017 and MCP23S17 16-bit I/O expander driver on epic-bus | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X |
| [`lib/modbus`](modules/modbus.md) | Modbus RTU slave for 8-bit PICs | PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/pid`](modules/pid.md) | Vendor-agnostic fixed-point PID controller | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/sdcard`](modules/sdcard.md) | SD/MMC over SPI block storage for PIC18F2455, 2550, 4455 and 4550 | PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/serial`](modules/serial.md) | Interrupt-driven ring-buffered UART | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/settings`](modules/settings.md) | EEPROM-backed settings blobs with CRC validation | PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/swuart`](modules/swuart.md) | Bit-banged full-duplex UART | PIC16F193X, PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/taskmgr`](modules/taskmgr.md) | Cooperative non-preemptive task scheduler for 8-bit PICs | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/tick`](modules/tick.md) | 1 ms timebase for 8-bit PICs | PIC16F193X, PIC16F628A, PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| [`lib/usb`](modules/usb.md) | USB CDC-ACM virtual serial port for PIC18F2455, 2550, 4455 and 4550 | PIC18Fxx5x |
